test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Ganesh Chaturthi begins on the fourth day of which of the following months of the Hindu calendar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhadrapad.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ganesh Chaturthi is celebrated on the fourth day of the Hindu month of **Bhadrapad**.
 
• Ganesh Chaturthi is also known as** Vinayak Chaturthi or Vinayak Chaviti or Ganeshotsav.**
 
• It is celebrated throughout India, especially in** Maharashtra and Goa.**
 
• Outside India, it is celebrated by the Hindu diaspora in **New Zealand, Australia, Canada, **and several other countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Historical records suggest that Ganesh Chaturthi celebrations were initiated by **Chatrapati Shivaji Maharaja,** to promote culture and nationalism.
 
• In** 1893, Bal Gangadhar Tilak organised Ganesh Utsav** as a social and religious function. It was him who put large hoarding with images of Lord Ganesh in pavilions and the man behind the tradition of immersion of huge Ganesh statues on the tenth day of the festival.
 
• 
 
 
 

 **Kartik**
 Kartik Maas is the **eighth month of the Hindu** calendar, which coincides with October or November in the Gregorian calendar
 
 

 **Magha**
 This festival is observed on the first day of Magh month as per Bengali Panjika. This is a Sankranti celebration in Assam, which is known as Magh Bihu. This year, **Magh Bihu** festival is being celebrated on 15 January , 2023.
 
 

 Ashwin 
 Month has both religious and spiritual significance. After the Tarpan period of ancestors, **Navrati** of goddess Durga are begun. **Dussehra** and** Ram Navami** are also major festivals of this time.
